title: デビュー戦の後に・伝説級のるんるん

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Woooo?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Wh-what is going on here? This is slow going, even for a debut race…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The runners start off at such a relaxed pace, it's like they were going for a stroll, not a run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But when they near the end, the speed picks up until the runners all hurtle past the finish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I'm back from my leisurely run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suppose she got lucky today. The other racers matched her pace, waiting to speed up in the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But if she continues at this tempo, she'll only be able to go so far. It'll be difficult to make progress in her schedule and races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer, is something the matter?
choice_data_list: We should talk about your schedule moving forward.
We should talk about your schedule moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh dearie. That sounds like I'll be racing almost nonstop for a while.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You wish for me to adopt a fast-paced schedule so that I might adapt to the rigor of the Twinkle Series, no?
choice_data_list: Right. At the rate we're going now…
Right. At the rate we're going now…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright's top goal is to win the Classic Triple Crown next year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's nothing wrong with doing things at one's own pace, but with her easygoing demeanor, we might run out of time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, Trainer. I have something to say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Do you truly think a schedule like that would suit me? I find taking things slow and steady far more comfortable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Perhaps we should set our sights a little higher. How does the Hopeful Stakes sound?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Why, yes! Since it is a race scheduled in December, I can take my time training. Plus…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: If I compete in the Hopeful Stakes, I will be making the contribution I've desired to for so long.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Bringing honor to the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: All Umamusume in the Mejiro family are brought up believing that one day they can fulfill that promise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "The Mejiro Umamusume are children of light, admired by all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: However, because I'm so easygoing, I haven't managed to add even the slightest flicker of light to our name. Not once in my life have I won.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: So I wish to compete as soon as I can in a G1 and contribute to the glory of the Mejiros. No matter what. At any cost.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Running the Hopeful Stakes before the G1 Classics… It's certainly an option, but only if she's legitimately got a shot at pulling it off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before I agree to anything, I need to know that she's capable and determined…
choice_data_list: Do you have the confidence to do it?
Do you have the confidence to do it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The confidence… How could I possibly? However…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: …I know that I must do it. Because I am a Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite the ease with which she speaks, an intense light burns in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no guarantee she will win, but she has the purpose to try. In that case…
choice_data_list: I understand. Let's run in the Hopeful Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You agree? Oh, what good news!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Without question, I will endeavor to run satisfactorily and produce a shining light for the Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her feelings persuade me to take this small risk…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But preparing for the G1 Hopeful Stakes won't be easy.
